info.title: Lightninger agent API
info.description: Agent API v1 of the Lightninger testnet venue (testnet4; USDT is a labelled demo asset). REST under /agent/v1 and the same methods as JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket at /agent/v1/ws (`x-rpc-method` names each). Reads are public; writes are authenticated by their own BIP340 signatures: owner-signed grants and revocations, agent-signed intents and acknowledgements. See docs/SHZ_AGENT_API.md.

Grant.description: AgentGrant (crates/shz-dex/src/routing/agents.rs). The owner signs `AgentGrant::id` (tagged hash SHZ/HFT06/AGENT-GRANT/V1) with BIP340.

Revocation.description: AgentRevocation: the owner signs its id (SHZ/HFT06/AGENT-REVOKE/V1).

PerpIntent.description: IntentV6 wire form (docs/SHZ_VENUE_API.md). `owner` is the account owner; the agent signs `id`.

OptionIntent.description: IntentV7 wire form (docs/SHZ_VENUE_OPTIONS.md); combos carry up to 4 legs.

x-websocket.protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0; every REST method by its x-rpc-method name, plus the methods below. Batches of 1..=50 requests.

channels.trades: perpetual, spot and option fills (trade, spot_trade, option_fill)
channels.options.book: option book or chain changed (option_book, options_series)
channels.account: some account changed (account, risk): re-read account.get

params.seq: integer, +1 per event on that channel

x-websocket.resync: resync {channel, since?}: the events after `since` if the server still holds all of them (`replay`), else a `snapshot` with the channel's current `seq`. A `gap` notification lists channels to resync after the connection fell behind.
x-websocket.heartbeat: every 15 s with server_us and each subscribed channel's seq
